title: Decide MIMI rules placement (crate vs mimid) and MLS library
description: Decision bead: do MIMI server rules go in a crate or the mimid consumer? AGENTS.md says spec rules belong in *-server crates. Also pick the MLS/TLS-codec library.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Decision recorded in notes and AGENTS.md.
notes: DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: MIMI server rules live in crate-jmap as crate-jmap-chat-mimi-server (plus crate-jmap-chat-mimi-client for 6k5d.8), on top of crate-jmap-chat-mimi-types (JMAP-fvnd) and the chat-server seams (JMAP-5mz6). MLS/TLS parsing via crates.io dependencies only (published crates cannot depend on git forks): openmls =0.9.1 with the extensions-draft feature and tls_codec =0.5.0 (mls, derive), matching mimid's crates.io pins. If a needed fix exists only in Mark's openmls fork, file a bead to upstream it rather than depending on the fork. mimid then depends on these crates. Record in AGENTS.md crate map when the crate is created.
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-20; decision recorded in notes
